svg.title: Where the code for one state and for one event lives
svg.desc: The same table of 4 states by 5 events, twice. With the State pattern each row is one class, so a new state is one new class. With an enum and a switch in each event method, each column is one method, so a new event is one new method.
svg.text: State pattern: one class per row
a new state = a new class
enum + switch: one method per column
